text:
Lenora: Quick heads-up — ETA for today's release shifts ~2 hours. Vendor sent a late perf regression we're debugging. Can we extend changelog cutoff to 14:30 PT? /cc @Matt @Anika

Matt: Ack. Scope it to non-breaking fixes only. If we take anything larger we should move to next train. I can hold the announce.

Anika: I'll freeze API surface changes now. QA will prioritize the vendor regression tests.

Deploy Bot: Deploy window scheduled 2026-03-17T21:00Z. New target requested: 2026-03-17T23:00Z. React with :thumbsup: to confirm.

Kevin: If we slip, I'll prep cherry-picks for release branch. Example commands:
```
git checkout release/v1.8
git cherry-pick -x abc1234
git push origin release/v1.8
```
I'll open the backport PRs in a few mins.

Sarah: QA here — can start a regression run in ~10m. ETA ~45m for perf + smoke. If you can point me to failing benchmark logs that helps.

Matt: Also will prepare a version bump PR to v1.8.3 and add a concise changelog entry. Keep entries tiny.

CI Bot: CI shows 2 flaky tests in staging; trying rerun.

Kevin: I'll queue the hotfix pipeline too: `./scripts/release/hotfix.sh --branch release/v1.8 --sha abc1234`

Lenora: Thanks. Plan: if QA signs off we'll keep the slip and ship at ~23:00Z; otherwise we abort and reschedule to tomorrow morning. I'll post an update to #announcements in 30m with final ETA.

Anika: For the announcement copy, suggest: "Minor delay to today's release for final perf validation; new ETA ~2 hours. We will update when QA completes." Keep it short.

Matt: :thumbsup: ping me when the changelog PR is open, I'll review quickly.

Kevin: PRs: https://git.internal/r/redwood/repo/pulls/789 (cherry-pick), https://git.internal/r/redwood/repo/pulls/790 (version bump)

Sarah: Regression run finished, perf looks stable after the fix — will do one more smoke.

Lenora: Great — we're go for 23:00Z. Matt, please merge the version bump after your review. I'll post to #announcements now.

Matt: Merged. Announce away.

Lenora: Announcement posted and pinned in #announcements. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
